transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I… I guess I got scared. Lately I keep thinking it might be easier if I just didn’t wake up. And sometimes driving home from the clinic, I catch myself wondering what would happen if I just… didn’t turn the wheel.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once found pleasurable?

Yeah… I have. I don’t really pick up my camera anymore, or check the bird feeders like I used to. Even the garden—I just… don’t really care what’s coming up. Those things used to make me feel like myself, so it’s… frightening.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It’s been… a long time. Around 11 months, I think. It was there before, but this past month has made it feel unbearable.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately—like trouble falling asleep, waking up often during the night, or sleeping much more than usual?

Yeah… sleep’s been pretty bad. I lie there replaying things I’ve messed up, or I wake up way too early and already feel exhausted. Even if I stay in bed longer, I don’t really feel rested… not enough to run or get through things normally.
Have you noticed a significant drop in your energy lately, or been feeling fatigued even when you haven’t done much?

Yes. It’s… it’s really noticeable. Even at work, just walking from the treatment area over to the lab benches feels like I’m dragging myself through mud. And when I get home, I can barely manage dinner or help with the evening routine.
Have you been feeling like you’re a failure or that you’ve let people down, or been blaming yourself for things more than usual?

Yeah… I do. I keep thinking I’m a bad person for feeling resentful about how disrupted everything is at home. And then I replay every impatient look, every sharp thing I’ve said, like it proves my husband and everyone would be better off without me.
Have you noticed that you've been moving more slowly than usual, or have you felt restless or fidgety lately?

I don’t know about moving slowly or fidgeting exactly… but I did get kind of wound up for a while. I took extra shifts, redid the whole care schedule at home, called contractors, tried to organize everyone’s tasks like it was some big hospital project. No one really asked me to do all that.
Have you had any thoughts about harming yourself or ending your life, and if so, have you thought about how you might do it?

Yes… I have. It’s hard to say.

Mostly I keep thinking it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up. And sometimes, driving home from the clinic, I’ll catch myself wondering what would happen if I just… didn’t turn the wheel.
Have you ever had a period like this before, where you felt down, lost interest in things, or struggled with your mood?
Yeah… I mean, not quite like this before. This has been hanging over me for… about eleven months, I guess. It was already there before this past month got so unbearable.
Have you ever experienced a time when you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or extremely confident—like you didn’t need much sleep or that you could take on the world?

Yeah… earlier this month, I guess I did. I felt almost… electrically upbeat for a bit. Like I was running hotter than normal.

But then I’d snap at people over stupid little things — a medication cup in the wrong place, someone changing the morning schedule. It didn’t feel like me.
